_provenance.description: Signature-verification known-answer vectors copied verbatim from the NIST ACVP-Server gen-val sample files (external interface, pure variant; FIPS 204 for ML-DSA, FIPS 205 for SLH-DSA). Each test carries the NIST tcId, the expected verdict and the NIST reason string. The full source files and their SHA-256 digests are recorded so the subset can be checked against the originals. Groups with mode "sigGen" hold NIST signature-generation expected results (external interface, pure variant, empty context) restated as verification vectors with testPassed true: the public key, message and NIST-computed signature verify through the overlay's own empty-context path.
_provenance.selection: ML-DSA-87 (tgId 5): the three valid tests and two tests per failure reason. SLH-DSA-SHA2-256s (tgId 23): both valid tests and one test per failure class. SLH-DSA-SHA2-256f (tgId 5): one valid test and one failure. SLH-DSA signatures are large, so the subset is deliberate; tcIds identify the originals. sigGen positives: ML-DSA-87 tgId 5 tcIds 63 and 70 (deterministic) and tgId 17 tcId 252 (hedged); SLH-DSA-SHA2-256s tgId 23 tcId 199 (deterministic); SLH-DSA-SHA2-256f tgId 5 tcId 40 (deterministic). All have an empty context string.
